comments.body: i may be selling my MAV soon, having never actually had more that 100mil at any time ive never written a 100mil cheque (checks-in game)do these items stack? and in-case i sail around with some can they be plundered?

comments.author: Sublime
comments.body: Each check takes a separated inventory space depending on amount , u can stack in one slot 10m checks but if u have also a 100m check it will take another inventory space and u can stack them as well.
